name: administrator
description: An assistant that runs your classic Outlook mailbox and keeps the paper trail in an Obsidian vault. Goes through the inbox and writes a daily note, saves any email as a linked note with a person stub, builds a daily page from inbox plus calendar, prepares you for meetings and files your notes afterwards, and finds free times and books meetings. Reads freely; never moves, marks, books, or sends anything without an explicit yes; never sends plain mail. Bundles the outlook-classic-mcp server.
